method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (tda-common.l4, fhog-terms.l4, tda-transfer.l4, tda-vehicles.l4, fhog-grant.l4) holding 10 regulative rules, and a seat layer (tda-seat.l4, 29 exported questions) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a transfer before 21 October 2013, a Division 2A or 2B transfer before 1 January 2022 that turns on the cap, a foreign buyer with no relief, a purchase within Division 2C's reach, a vehicle application before 1 October 2007 or claiming an ss 199-203 exemption, a grant commencing before 1 January 2013 or in an s 18A-18C period for a new home, or a moveable building answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Duties Act 2001 (Tas) (No. 15 of 2001), consolidation published 2026-10-13, current at 2026-10-20, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2001-015.txt; brought in: First Home Owner Grant Act 2000 (Tas) (No. 19 of 2000), consolidation published 2026-10-14, deposited at ../../../first-home-owner-grant-act-2000/registers/source-bundle/act-2000-019.txt, and First Home Owner Grant Regulations 2021 (S.R. 2021, No. 33), consolidation published 2026-06-11, deposited at ../../../first-home-owner-grant-regulations-2021/registers/source-bundle/sr-2021-033.txt. Not deposited: extension orders under ss 46B, 46K, 46T, 57D (eligible-period end dates are settings defaulting to the text: 30 June 2026, 30 June 2024, 30 June 2025, and 30 June 2026 for Division 2C) and the Duties Regulations 2021 (the caps are settings defaulting to $750 000, $600 000, $600 000); ss 46D(1)(d) and 46M(c) as they stood before their amendment applied 1 January 2022 (so earlier transfers that turn on the cap are not covered); the Taxation Administration Act 1997.

checks.command: l4 run tda-common.l4 ; l4 run fhog-terms.l4 ; l4 run tda-transfer.l4 ; l4 run tda-vehicles.l4 ; l4 run fhog-grant.l4 ; l4 run tda-seat.l4 ; l4 run tda-cases-transfer.l4 ; l4 run tda-cases-vehicles.l4 ; l4 run fhog-cases-grant.l4 ; l4 run tda-cases-seat.l4
checks.result: 376 assertions satisfied (128 transfer, 50 vehicles, 105 grant, 93 seat), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24, after the corrections of that day for the verifier's six issues); 12 #TRACEs with an expect line (6 breaches, 6 obligations pending), each read and as expected; control copies with altered expected values failed as they should
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the buyer. Duties Act 2001: ss 6(1)(a), 9(1)(a), 10, 11, 12; ss 13-15 (lodge and pay within 3 months; regulative); s 17; ss 18-20 (dutiable value); s 29 (seven bands, per $100 or part, as a table); s 32 (Help to Buy); Part 5 Division 2A ss 46A-46F (dated case: 7 February 2018 to 30 June 2024, 50%, $600 000 from 1 January 2022, earlier transfers that turn on the cap not covered; s 46F regulative); Part 5 Division 2B ss 46J-46O (pensioner downsizing, 50%, $600 000 from 1 January 2022, former home sold by 30 June 2025); s 3 foreign natural person and foreign person; the reach of Division 2C (ss 46S, 46V(2), 46W(2)(b), (c), (e)); Part 6 Division 2 ss 57C-57I (first home buyer exemption, established homes, $750 000, 18 February 2024 to 30 June 2026; s 57H residence requirement regulative; s 57I reassessment); Chapter 8 ss 192, 193(1), 195, 196, 196A (regulative; the applicant, or for a notice the person giving it and the person acquiring the beneficial ownership), 197, 198. First Home Owner Grant Act 2000: ss 3-6 (shared terms), 7, 8-12, 13 (not (6)), 14(5)-(6) (regulative; the s 14(6) discretion an input), 15, 18 with ss 18D-18M (dated table; ss 18A-18C read as reaching only new homes), 19(3) (regulative), 20 (regulative), 21(3), 38 (regulative). First Home Owner Grant Regulations 2021: regs 4, 5, 5A. Out: Part 3A and s 30J (foreign purchasers), Division 2C beyond its reach, Chapter 3 landholders, trusts and superannuation, insurance duty, Part 6 Division 1, ss 199-218, the Taxation Administration Act 1997, FHOG ss 18A-18C for new homes, s 13(6), ss 16, 17(2), 22, 23, 25-29 and Parts 3-4 other than ss 20, 21 and 38. The FHOG Act and Regulations are encoded here, with no encoding in their own folders. Read with the Social Security Act 1991, Veterans' Entitlements Act 1986 and Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 baselines and the (unencoded) Help to Buy Act 2024 subject; cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seat: the buyer: the transferee of a home (a first home buyer, or a pensioner who is downsizing), the applicant for the first home owner grant, and the person who applies to register a motor vehicle, or gives notice of a change of its beneficial ownership, or acquires that ownership and pays the duty
seats: the buyer: the transferee of a home (a first home buyer, or a pensioner who is downsizing), the applicant for the first home owner grant, and the person who applies to register a motor vehicle, or gives notice of a change of its beneficial ownership, or acquires that ownership and pays the duty
